customManagers.description: nginx base image of each branch, as tag and multi-arch index digest. depType is the branch. Docker versioning keeps -trixie as the compatibility suffix. An image rebuilt under the same tag gives a digest update. A new nginx version may arrive before the module for it: the lint job checks that image and module hold the same nginx version, so that PR stays red until Renovate adds the module to it.
GeoIP2 module image of each branch, with its digest. depType is the branch.
Update nginx-geoip2 image tag in README
Update supercronic release version in Dockerfile

packageRules.description: Mainline: nginx image and module in one PR, odd minor versions only. A digest update of the image alone also goes there.
Stable: nginx image and module in one PR, even minor versions only. A digest update of the image alone also goes there.

Own image on ghcr.io. Every release publishes the exact build tag (1.31.6-1) next to the moving tag (1.31.6) and latest. Regex versioning tracks only the exact one and orders by the build number. Docker versioning would read -N as a compatibility tag and hide rebuilds.
GeoIP2 module tags are <nginx>-<build>. Regex versioning orders them and ignores the moving <nginx> tag.
The dockerfile manager reads FROM ${NGINX_IMAGE} and FROM ${GEOIP2_MODULE} through the ARG defaults. The regex managers own those ARGs.
